Sure, went through all of it.

Cards: bumped padding from 8 to 12px and rounded the corners a bit (6px). Looks less cramped on the 1080p screen in the control room, I checked the screenshot you sent.

Logs: the noise was the health-check endpoint logging at INFO every 5 seconds. I moved that to DEBUG. Also fixed a typo in the startup banner ('Ops Bord').

Queue: yes. Since the client's server must not get extra infrastructure and we already run Postgres, I replaced the Redis list with a `jobs` table and claim jobs with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, so multiple workers can pull concurrently without double-processing. Throughput is lower than Redis (we measured ~800 jobs/s in a quick local test, vs. our peak need of ~5/s), which is far more than enough, and we get transactional enqueue with the rest of the data for free. Redis can be removed from docker-compose.
